aggregated_by: aggregate_p2f.py, mechanical evaluation of pre-registered gates in campaign.json; no amendments

gates_source.G0_capability: arm recall >= 0.90 at every stratum <= 1611 (64, 101, 161, 255, 404, 641, 1016, 1611), else INCONCLUSIVE-UNDERTRAINED for that arm (continuation decision to operator/Hani; NOT a confirmation of decline).
gates_source.GS_shape_nowindow: THE question, arm_nowindow only, over strata 4048->7792 (15 strata): FLAT (all >= 0.90) => arm4's decline is a pretrained-checkpoint property, NOT fundamental; the p2d/p2e suspension of LAW_ARITHMETIC_TRANSFERS is resolvable in the law's favor with the residual attributed to checkpoint long-context capability. DECLINING (monotone-ish decline mirroring arm4's shape: Spearman rho < -0.7 over the 15 strata AND final stratum 7792 recall < 0.5) => the decline generalizes to from-scratch training; the law's far-field account needs an explicit capability-decay term; the suspension stands. MIXED (anything else) => report shape, no claim.
gates_source.GW_window_control: arm_w4096: recall >= 0.90 at all strata <= 4048 AND recall <= p_chance_measured_matched_regime + 0.05 at all strata >= 4144 => instrument + scale validated (sharp step at this block size). If GW FAILS the whole campaign is INSTRUMENT-SUSPECT and no GS claim is made -- said so explicitly in the decision.
gates_source.precedence: GW first (instrument validity), then G0 on arm_nowindow, then GS. decision.json is produced mechanically by aggregate_p2f.py from these definitions; no amendments after launch. Instrument crash-robustness fixes that do not touch scoring or gates are permitted and logged, per p2c/p2d/p2e precedent.

campaign_outcome: INSTRUMENT_SUSPECT: GW_window_control failed -- the positive-control arm did not reproduce a sharp step at W=4096 at this scale, so the whole campaign is instrument-suspect; no GS claim is made. Shapes reported for diagnosis only.
